filters.pointOnly: Without a radius, Apply searches only the 0.01° cell containing this point (approximately 1 km per side).
filters.cleared: Search cleared. Select filters or a point, then Apply.

errors.dateRange: Select both dates, with the end date on or after the start date.
errors.coordinates: Enter both latitude and longitude within their valid ranges, or clear both fields.
errors.radius: If you enter a radius, provide latitude and longitude and use a value greater than 0 and up to 300 km.

calendar.title: Burning activity calendar
calendar.error: Unable to load burning activity calendar

map.title: Burning activity map
map.description: Explore the burning activity across the globe. The map shows the locations of burning events based on satellite data.
map.error: Unable to load burning activity map

area.title: Area of interest
area.none: No area selected. Draw a circle on the map or enter latitude and longitude in the filters.
area.point: Point {lat}, {lon} · draw a circle or enter a radius
area.outsideDescription: The circle must be completely inside El Salvador. Draw it again within the country.
area.pointOutsideDescription: Latitude must be between {south} and {north}, and longitude between {west} and {east}.
area.radiusOutsideDescription: The circle extends beyond El Salvador. Reduce the radius so it stays inside the country.

historicalTrends.title: Historical trends
historicalTrends.description: Compare regional MODIS, VIIRS and harmonized activity over time using the selected dates. The table and bars use all applied filters.

compare.empty: Select at least one year (and one month) to compare.

table.title: Aggregated activity per period
table.description: Total per period and change vs the previous period. Click a column header to sort.
table.firstPeriod: First period: there is no previous period to compare with
table.fromZeroHint: The previous period had 0, so the % change is not defined

line.title: Regional activity over time
line.description: Compare MODIS, VIIRS and Harmonized activity for the selected years and months.
line.harmonizedScope: Regional comparison in cell-days: MODIS Aqua, reference VIIRS and harmonized MODIS-equivalent activity. Only the applied date range affects this chart; point, radius, instrument and satellite filters apply to the table and bars.
line.unsupportedFilters: The harmonized API does not support area, satellite or single-instrument filters. Showing the filtered sensor counts without a harmonized curve.
line.harmonizedUnavailable: The regional comparison is unavailable. The three series could not be loaded.

bar.descriptionMonthly: Each bar is one year; months outside the data range have no bar.
bar.ariaLabelMonthly: Bar chart of {metric} per month for the years {years}
bar.ariaLabelYearly: Bar chart of {metric} for the years {years}

csv.sensorScope: Sensor counts use all applied filters. Blank values indicate a sensor excluded by the instrument filter. Sensor cell counts can overlap and must not be added to reproduce the combined table.
csv.error: Unable to export CSV. Please try again.

empty.title: No activity data
empty.description: There are no periods for the current filters. Try a wider date range or another area.

error.title: Unable to load historical trends
error.description: The burning activity data could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
